name: GBIF Species Occurrences
description: Bounded, sampled species-occurrence records from the Global Biodiversity Information Facility.

metadata.label: GBIF Species Occurrences
metadata.constraints: Requires a bounded extent. Interactive results are capped at 300 records per GBIF page and AEGIS defaults to 100. Results are observations/occurrences, not a complete species inventory. Preserve basis of record, event date, dataset key, coordinate uncertainty, issues, and licence metadata.
metadata.human_summary: Species occurrence records reported to GBIF inside the selected map extent.
search_examples: which species have been observed here
show biodiversity observations in this area
find GBIF species records around Lugano
disambiguation_notes: Occurrence records indicate reported observations or specimens. They do not prove current presence, absence, abundance, or a complete species inventory.
metadata.rate_limit_notes: GBIF may rate-limit intensive search traffic; use bounded queries and small interactive limits.

knownLimitations: Interactive results are sampled and capped.
Occurrence quality, coordinate uncertainty, and record licensing vary by contributing dataset.
Absence of returned records must not be interpreted as species absence.
